_comment: Game profiles. A profile only selects tools and records facts/gaps for one game; it never changes other games. 'verified' lists what was actually run; 'gaps' what is known missing. 'coverage' says how far this game is supported: 'active' (worked on here, real captures/data, kept working), 'extension' (no local data; the profile + adapters exist so it can be picked up when a capture appears; nothing verified).

wuwa.name: Wuthering Waves
wuwa.capture_notes: RenderDoc D3D11 captures exist (user-made, 590MB-2.1GB). WWMI is the 3DMigoto route.
verified: RenderDoc D3D11 capture -> UE 5.8 and Unity 6 scene (bridge scene, 19k instances, camera matched)
whole-library SourceProbe dump-index (41,133 SM_ packages / 157,691 sections) -> 96% of scene instances carry their source asset name in UE and Unity
second capture (frame 61250) reconstructed end-to-end: VP fit 0.96, UE import 851 meshes / 26,944 instances
translucent pass exported separately and merged: 67 draws, 73 instances placed with affine transforms
water draw identified exactly (SM_Old_Wat_08AH LOD0 section0) and given a translucent water material in UE (linkage verified by asset inspection)
identify reproduces 6 independently established frame-61250 source matches (same object / LOD / section)
gaps: water does not read visually in the UE game-mode screenshot yet; the mesh/material are linked but the plane is not visible (cause not isolated; winding vs negative-Z instance scale is the leading candidate)
particle / billboard translucent draws cannot be placed by local->clip fit; they are skipped rather than faked
depth-only pass (leaf interaction proxies) duplicates main-pass foliage with degenerate transforms; not merged
no water-line / foam / refraction / absorption / caustics; water is a flat tinted translucent preview
sky + lighting not reconstructed
skinned/wind meshes baked at capture pose
instanced draws that use one section of a larger array mesh stay unmatched (whole-mesh identity only)
~11k SM_ packages have no rendered LOD data in the mounted pak view and cannot be indexed
key handling stays inside the user's SourceProbe

zzz.name: Zenless Zone Zero
zzz.engine_version: Unity (HoYo custom bundles); 3.2.0 in user's evidence
zzz.install: not installed on this machine (evidence only)
zzz.packaging: HoYo custom blocks; CAB map required
zzz.capture_notes: ZZMI via XXMI Launcher; Frame Analysis dumps (not .rdc). RenderDoc route untested (anti-cheat).
verified: 3DMigoto Frame01 (user's, 1.9GB) ingested: 213 draws, 167 meshes, 83 textures decoded, 6 s

world/camera placement adapter wired into build-model (placement_adapter zzz): 72/213 draws yield a rigid vs-cb1 world matrix; 58 picked character draws all placed; camera from vs-cb0 (frame projection vs-cb3); UE and Unity re-imported and rendered end-to-end
character body/hair/shoes rendered upright and textured in Unity and in UE (model space, unity->ue conversion exercised)
user's earlier UE reconstruction used AnimeStudio exports (verified-prior)
gaps: head/face parts missing: ZZZ draws characters via GPU-driven indirect draws whose arguments are not in the dump
141/213 draws (screen-space UI and other non-rigid passes) have no world matrix and are left unplaced, not faked
the character is emitted in bind pose (POSITION0); skinned animation is not evaluated

the reference frame is a UI screen: SSIM/mask metrics compare a world-space render against UI art and are not a measure of placement quality (the projection check is draw 106 vs its dumped RT alpha mask, IoU 0.9783)
AnimeStudio cannot be re-run: game not installed

endfield.capture_notes: AntiCheatExpert present. Normal RenderDoc launch is opt-in per request; no protection bypass or global/child hook. Live capture is being tested, not yet verified.
verified: UnityPy opens globalgamemanagers (real file) and reports the Unity version
gaps: asset containers unreadable without game-specific decryption (no generic tool handles them)
capture route untested
this is the clearest example of a game that needs its own source adapter
endfield.status_note: Capture-first integration: launch/target/trigger use normal RenderDoc APIs with explicit per-request consent. Source export is a separate bounded proof; no full-map preparation is required. Neither route is verified on Endfield yet.
